objective: Build a publishable, evidence-backed OpenFOAM NACA 0012 validation ladder by changing one solver component at a time.
publication_status: not_authorized; user review is required before publishing results
design_use_status: blocked until the complete ladder passes

failed_attempt_retained.cause: The official Allrun wrapper did not propagate OpenMPI's refusal to execute as root; reconstructPar then found no times and the wrapper returned success.
failed_attempt_retained.corrective_execution_change: Run the pristine official case as uid 1000 without modifying tutorial inputs.

official_documentation_mismatch.decision: Retain the unchanged packaged run as an installation and tutorial-integrity control. Reconstruct the separately documented NASA setup before asserting validation agreement.

cfl3d_force_limit.rationale: Carry forward the already declared NACA 0012 numerical-independence scale; do not widen it to pass a result.

profile_metrics: surface Cp RMS and maximum absolute difference on matched coordinates
surface Cf mean ratio, RMS difference, and maximum absolute difference on matched coordinates
fixed_comparison_rules.profile_acceptance: report-only until coordinate mapping and comparison exclusions are declared before the first documented-control solve
fixed_comparison_rules.failure_policy: Preserve failed and null results. Do not tune freestream values, turbulence coefficients, normalization, or tolerances to the target result.

ordered_gates.name: unchanged_packaged_tutorial
ordered_gates.purpose: Verify the pinned v2512 image can execute the exact upstream airFoil2D tutorial and expose wrapper failures.

ordered_gates.name: documented_nasa_spalart_allmaras_control
ordered_gates.change_from_previous: Replace the packaged demonstration mesh and conditions with the official documentation's NASA 897x257 mesh and stated SA conditions.

ordered_gates.name: stock_openfoam_sst
ordered_gates.change_from_previous: Change only turbulence model and required turbulence fields from SA to packaged kOmegaSST.

ordered_gates.name: exact_nasa_sstm_incompressible
ordered_gates.change_from_previous: Change only the stock SST implementation to the provenance-pinned exact NASA SSTm runtime model.

ordered_gates.name: exact_nasa_sstm_compressible
ordered_gates.change_from_previous: Change only the flow solver and thermodynamic closure from incompressible simpleFoam to compressible rhoSimpleFoam.

terminal_rule: Stop at the first failed gate, localize the discrepancy, and require a predeclared mechanism test before continuing. Passing the ladder validates only this benchmark and operating point, not rocket aerodynamics generally.
